title: Generation plan
description: What one generation will write, derived and inspectable before any file exists. specs/0004 R23 derives it from four inputs — the scope, the pack's declaration, the manifest, and the frozen placement decision — and forbids authoring it, forbids it holding a rule, and admits no model into the derivation. R26 makes it producible without writing anything, which is what lets R25 validate it first. R28 makes identical inputs yield a byte-identical plan, and R29 requires determinism to be tested here as well as at the output: a test covering only produced source cannot distinguish a nondeterministic plan from a nondeterministic template, and testing the plan is cheaper and sharper because it is independent of whether any template is correct.

entries.description: specs/0004 R24: each entry names the knowledge object, the artifact class, the track, the target path, and whether it is locked or new. An entry with no target path cannot be validated under R25. Empty is legal and meaningful: a scope whose node types yield no class under the active pack produces no entry, and R11 reports the types rather than the plan pretending to cover them.

state.description: specs/0004 R24: a locked entry takes its path from the manifest and a new one from the frozen placement decision. The flag is what lets a diff distinguish expected variation from a finding — R5 requires a report to distinguish a first generation from a regeneration under lock, and this is the field it reads.
